scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n core,api,dashboard "npm run dev -w @payment-risk/core" "npm run dev -w @payment-risk/api" "npm run dev -w @payment-risk/dashboard"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @payment-risk/core && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.build: npm run build -w @payment-risk/core && npm run build -w @payment-risk/api && npm run build -w @payment-risk/dashboard && npm run build -w @payment-risk/sdk
